remarks: Seller requests all offers be submitted by Monday at 12:00pm Step back in time while enjoying modern investment opportunity at this charming antique two-family in the heart of South Norwalk. Thoughtfully converted years ago, this gracious home retains its historic character with beautiful original moldings, soaring ceilings, and an abundance of natural light throughout. A welcoming front porch and elegant entrance set the tone for this special property. The first-floor unit offers one bedroom, dining room with fireplace, large eat-in kitchen and light filled living room. The second-floor unit boasts two bedrooms and seasonal water views that add a touch of coastal charm to everyday living. Period details and architectural integrity shine in every corner, from the detailed millwork to the generous ceiling heights that create an airy, open feel. The unfinished basement provides shared laundry hookups and additional storage potential. Completing the package is a detached two-car garage-a rare and valuable amenity in this walkable neighborhood. Enjoy South Norwalk's vibrant dining and entertainment scene, Metro-North access, and waterfront parks, all while building equity in this income-producing gem. Whether you're an investor seeking solid rental income, an owner-occupant looking to offset your mortgage, or someone who appreciates timeless architecture, this property delivers on all fronts.
